chunks: So fear God and follow me.

key_terms.فَاتَّقُوا: Fear God / Be conscious of God

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran command believers to do in relation to God and the Prophet?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse serves as a divine endorsement of the Prophet's authority, linking spiritual piety (taqwa) directly to obedience (ita'ah) to establish the foundation of prophetic leadership. Shia scholarship often views this as a precursor to the concept of Wilayah, emphasizing that true faith requires adherence to the Prophet's guidance as the interpreter of God's will. This dual commandment underscores the inseparable nature of inner devotion and external obedience in Islamic theology.
